name: Minoxidil 5% Topical Solution
short_description: Clinically proven topical vasodilator that reactivates shrunken hair follicles and stimulates active anagen phase hair regrowth.
usage_instructions: Apply 1 ml directly to the affected scalp areas using the calibrated dropper twice daily (morning and evening). Gently massage with fingertips. Apply on clean, dry scalp.
timeline_to_results: Noticeable initial baby hairs at 90 days; peak density at 180 days. Continuous daily usage is required to maintain regrown hair.
adaptation_warning: DREAD SHEDDING: Increased hair shedding between Day 15 and Day 30 is a completely normal biological sign that dormant telogen hairs are being pushed out by new anagen growth. Do not pause application.
contraindications: Do not apply on irritated, sunburned, or broken skin.
Do not apply immediately before or after chemical treatments.
Avoid washing hair for at least 4 hours post-application.
safety_level: Safe OTC; discontinue and consult physician if unexpected dizziness or tachycardia occurs.

name: Topical Minoxidil 5% + Finasteride 0.1% Solution
short_description: Dual-action powerhouse solution that combines follicle vasodilation with localized DHT inhibition to halt hair fall and promote dense regrowth.
usage_instructions: Apply exactly 1 ml once daily, preferably at bedtime, on affected dry scalp areas. Spread gently with fingertips. Wash hands thoroughly with soap after application.
timeline_to_results: Halted hair loss in 60-90 days; visible thickening and regrowth in 4 to 6 months.
adaptation_warning: Transient scalp dryness or mild flaking may occur during the first 3 weeks due to topical carrier evaporation. This is not a drug allergy.
contraindications: Strictly for adult males only.
Must not be handled by pregnant or lactating women.
Do not ingest orally.
safety_level: Doctor-prescribed topical compound; minimal systemic absorption compared to oral finasteride.

name: DHT Blocker Anti-Hairfall Shampoo
short_description: Sulfate-free scalp purifying shampoo enriched with natural DHT inhibitors and nourishing vitamins to strengthen hair roots.
usage_instructions: Apply to wet hair and scalp. Massage gently for 2-3 minutes to allow DHT blockers to penetrate follicle roots. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use 3-4 times weekly.
timeline_to_results: Immediate reduction in wash-related hair breakage; improved scalp clarity within 2 weeks.
adaptation_warning: Zero adjustment shedding. Mild tingling sensation from caffeine is normal.
contraindications: None; gentle daily formula.
Avoid contact with eyes.

name: Hair Growth Serum (Redensyl 3% + Procapil 3% + Capixyl 2%)
short_description: Water-based, non-greasy clinical hair serum powered by multi-peptide active complexes that reactivate dormant hair stem cells.
usage_instructions: Apply 1-2 ml onto clean scalp once daily at bedtime. Non-sticky water base absorbs in 60 seconds without leaving oiliness. No need to wash off.
timeline_to_results: Reduced hair fall in 4-6 weeks; visible density enhancement in 90-120 days.
adaptation_warning: Rarely causes shedding compared to Minoxidil. Safe to use continuously without dependency.
contraindications: Do not combine directly with heavy grease or pomades simultaneously.
safety_level: Non-hormonal peptide formulation with zero systemic side effects.

name: Anti-Dandruff Ketoconazole 2% Shampoo
short_description: Medical-grade antifungal shampoo that targets Malassezia yeast to permanently eradicate stubborn flakes, itchiness, and seborrheic dermatitis.
usage_instructions: Apply onto wet scalp. Work into a lather and LEAVE ON SCALP FOR 5 MINUTES before rinsing to allow antifungal action. Use 2 times per week for 4 weeks, then once weekly for maintenance.
timeline_to_results: Noticeable flake reduction after 2 washes; complete resolution of itching in 14 days.
adaptation_warning: May cause temporary scalp dryness if left on longer than 5 minutes. Follow with a gentle hydrating conditioner on hair strands.
contraindications: Do not use daily.
Ensure scalp is completely dry before applying topical Minoxidil afterwards.

name: Biotin Hair Gummies for Men
short_description: Delicious strawberry-flavored chewable gummies formulated with high-potency D-Biotin, Zinc, and essential hair vitamins.
usage_instructions: Chew 1 gummy daily post breakfast or lunch. No water required.
timeline_to_results: Noticeable improvement in hair shaft strength and nail hardness in 60 days.
contraindications: Do not exceed recommended dose.
Consult physician if taking specific lab blood tests (Biotin may alter thyroid panels).

name: 0.5mm Titanium Micro-Needling Derma Roller
short_description: Precision micro-needling device with 540 cross-lined titanium alloy micro-needles to stimulate dormant facial hair follicles.
usage_instructions: Sanitize roller in 70% isopropyl alcohol for 5 minutes. Roll gently over patchy cheek areas 4-8 times in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions. Use MAXIMUM 1-2 times per week at night.
timeline_to_results: Dormant follicle stimulation visible in 60 to 90 days of consistent weekly use.
adaptation_warning: CRITICAL RULE: Temporary mild redness (erythema) for 1-2 hours is normal. NEVER apply active chemical serums or beard oils immediately onto open micro-punctures. Wait at least 12-24 hours before applying active oils.
contraindications: Do not press hard or draw blood.
Never share derma rollers.
Do not use over active cystic acne or open sores.
Replace roller head every 60-90 days.
safety_level: Safe physical tool when strict sanitization and 24h rest protocols are maintained.

name: Beard Growth Oil (Redensyl + Procapil)
short_description: Non-greasy beard growth accelerator infused with plant-based actives and cold-pressed botanical oils to nourish patchy beard areas.
usage_instructions: Dispense 3-5 drops onto palms and massage into beard roots and skin once daily at night. On derma-rolling days, DO NOT APPLY on the same night—apply only 24 hours later.
timeline_to_results: Softened beard hair in 2 weeks; new follicle emergence in 60-90 days.
adaptation_warning: Zero shedding. Lightweight, absorbs cleanly without staining collars.
contraindications: Do not apply on fresh micro-needled skin within 24 hours.

name: 2% Salicylic Acid Acne Face Wash
short_description: Oil-soluble BHA cleanser that penetrates deep into facial pores to dissolve trapped sebum, clear blackheads, and prevent cystic breakouts.
usage_instructions: Take a coin-sized amount onto wet palms. Lather gently on face for 60 seconds, paying attention to T-zone (forehead, nose, chin). Rinse with cold water. Use morning and night.
timeline_to_results: Noticeable grease reduction from Day 1; active acne reduction within 14-21 days.
adaptation_warning: Mild transient purging (small whiteheads emerging) during Days 7-14 is normal as trapped sebum is pushed to the surface.
contraindications: Always follow with a moisturizer.
MUST wear sunscreen (SPF 50) when going outdoors because BHAs increase UV photosensitivity.

name: 10% Niacinamide Daily Glow Face Serum
short_description: Multitasking Vitamin B3 serum that minimizes enlarged pores, fades post-acne dark marks, and strengthens the epidermal barrier.
usage_instructions: Apply 2-3 drops to cleansed facial skin in the morning and evening before moisturizer. Pat gently until fully absorbed.
timeline_to_results: Refined pore appearance in 2 weeks; visible lightening of dark acne marks in 6-8 weeks.
adaptation_warning: Zero purging. Soothing and non-irritating for everyday barrier maintenance.
contraindications: Safe to combine with Salicylic Acid.
If combining with pure L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), use Niacinamide in AM and Vitamin C in PM.

name: Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
short_description: Water-burst lightweight gel moisturizer that quenches dehydrated skin without adding oiliness or clogging pores in hot Indian weather.
usage_instructions: Dot evenly across face and neck after serum application. Massage until absorbed. Use twice daily (AM and PM).
adaptation_warning: Zero irritation. Safe post-cleansing and post-shaving.
contraindications: None.

name: Mineral Matte Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++
short_description: Ultra-matte broad-spectrum sunscreen designed for men's skin. Zero white cast, water-resistant, and non-greasy.
usage_instructions: Apply generous 2-finger lengths to face and neck 15 minutes before stepping outdoors. Reapply every 3-4 hours if sweating or outdoors.
timeline_to_results: Immediate shielding against UVA/UVB rays and blue light.
adaptation_warning: Zero stinging. Mandatory companion when using Salicylic Acid or Minoxidil.
contraindications: None.

name: Pure Himalayan Shilajit Resin (Lab-Certified)
short_description: Original purified black gold resin sourced from 18,000 ft Himalayan altitudes, rich in >75% Fulvic Acid and 84+ trace minerals.
key_actives: Purified Himalayan Asphaltum (Shilajit) Resin >75% Fulvic Acid
usage_instructions: Dissolve a pea-sized amount (300-500 mg using the calibrated spoon provided) in a cup of lukewarm water or warm milk. Drink once daily in the morning on an empty stomach or 30 minutes before gym workouts.
timeline_to_results: Noticeable energy surge in 7-10 days; peak cellular ATP recovery in 60-90 days.
adaptation_warning: Intense earthy, mineral taste is normal and indicates genuine resin purity without chemical masking.
contraindications: Do not take if you have severe kidney stones or high iron overload (hemochromatosis).
Never dissolve in boiling water or alcohol.
safety_level: Every batch independently tested by accredited 3rd party labs with heavy metal reports (lead, mercury, arsenic < safe limits).

name: Ashwagandha 500mg (KSM-66 Extract)
short_description: Gold-standard KSM-66 full-spectrum Ashwagandha root extract to lower cortisol, fight stress, and boost restorative deep sleep.
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily after dinner with water or milk before sleeping.
timeline_to_results: Calmer mind and improved sleep latency within 10-14 days; cortisol reduction in 30 days.
contraindications: Consult doctor if suffering from autoimmune thyroid disorders.

name: Daily Multivitamin for Men
short_description: Comprehensive daily micronutrient formula featuring 24 vitamins, minerals, and herbal extracts customized for active men.
key_actives: Vitamins A, B-Complex, C, D3, E
usage_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily immediately after breakfast with a glass of water.
timeline_to_results: Sustained daily energy and reduced mid-day fatigue within 2 weeks.
adaptation_warning: Bright yellow urine is harmless and indicates safe excretion of excess water-soluble Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin).
contraindications: Do not take on an empty stomach to avoid mild nausea.
safety_level: 100% RDA aligned for Indian adult men.
